question: When and by what means must the ritual installation be performed?
premises: The rite is set on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight.
The performance takes place at night.
Installation is accomplished by means of the mantra.
inference: The ritual installation must be performed at night on the bright fortnight's fourteenth day using the mantra.
plain_english: On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight, at night, having established it by the mantra.
